label: copy-phase input "a" (echoed a) near the end of short sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original or <DEL> steps) when the fed-back input is the letter a (99% of activation mass has in_tok=a, always a repeat occurrence), in short sequences (L=3-5 hold 99% of mass) at the last one or two outputs (to_go<=1 holds ~95% of mass). Strongest activations are L=3 sequences where a is the second original token, e.g. z a 1 <DEL> z [a]; magnitude falls with L (L=4 next, L=5 weaker, L>=6 near zero). Does not fire on a in the original phase, on other tokens (residual weak hits on q, k, 0 etc.), or on echoed a early in long sequences. Precision is incomplete (~0.74): many echoed-a steps in L=4-5 sequences stay silent, so the length/position gating is softer than the predicate.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: a, q, k, 0, d, c; least: 3, x, v, e) and the token being output (most: a, c, q, 0, 1, w; least: z, 3, s, -); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, L=3, t=5.
